title: HSK 3 Practice 2
description: More HSK-3-style practice with this batch: word bank (再, 又, 为了, 对 …), true/false traps like 差点儿没, reading and sentence building.

points.title: 选词填空 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Word bank: 再, 又, 终于, 差点, 为了, 对.
points.body:
- 再 = again (future); 又 = again (already).
- 为了 + goal; 对 + 感兴趣 / 好.
examples: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōngguó}{文化|wénhuà}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìngqù}。
I'm very interested in Chinese culture.

points.title: 判断对错 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Watch out: 差点儿没赶上 = almost missed it — **but caught it**. 结果 introduces the real outcome.
points.body: - 本来以为 … 结果 … = expected X, but in the end Y.

points.title: 阅读理解 (HSK 3)
points.summary: 后来 marks what changed; 另外 adds another reason; 通过 tells you how.
points.body: - Read for the **current** situation after 后来 / 现在.
examples: Later I found out the subway is faster.

points.title: 完成句子 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Build the sentence, then pick the ★ piece.
points.body:
- 又 + 把 + object + verb.
- 对 + topic + 很感兴趣.
- 为了 + goal at the front.
examples: You'd better ask the teacher first.

questions.prompt: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{的|de}{菜|cài}{太|tài}{好吃|hǎochī}{了|le}，{下|xià}{次|cì}{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{想|xiǎng}（　）{来|lái}。
notes: 又 is for repetitions that already happened.
终于 needs 了 and a long wait.
questions.translation: The food here is so good — I want to come again next time.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{今天|jīntiān}（　）{没|méi}{来|lái}{上课|shàngkè}，{已经|yǐjīng}{是|shì}{第三|dì-sān}{次|cì}{了|le}。
questions.translation: He missed class again today — that's the third time.

questions.prompt: （　）{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{好|hǎo}{工作|gōngzuò}，{他|tā}{每天|měitiān}{都|dōu}{学习|xuéxí}{到|dào}{很|hěn}{晚|wǎn}。
questions.translation: To find a good job, he studies late every night.
I'm very interested in Chinese culture.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{本来|běnlái}{以为|yǐwéi}{考试|kǎoshì}{会|huì}{很|hěn}{难|nán}，{结果|jiéguǒ}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎndān}，{大家|dàjiā}{都|dōu}{考|kǎo}{得|de}{不错|búcuò}。

★ {考试|kǎoshì}{很|hěn}{难|nán}。
questions.explanation: **以为 … 结果** = expected, but actually.
notes: 以为 it would be hard — 结果 it was easy.
questions.translation: I'd thought the exam would be hard, but it turned out easy — everyone did well. ★ The exam was hard.

questions.prompt:
{他|tā}{学|xué}{了|le}{三|sān}{年|nián}{中文|Zhōngwén}，{还|hái}{去|qù}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{中国|Zhōngguó}，{怪不得|guàibude}{他|tā}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōngguó}{这么|zhème}{了解|liǎojiě}。

★ {他|tā}{去|qù}{过|guo}{中国|Zhōngguó}。
notes: 去过两次中国 — he's been twice.
questions.translation: He's studied Chinese for three years and been to China twice — no wonder he knows China so well. ★ He has been to China.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{差点儿|chàdiǎnr}{没|méi}{赶|gǎn}{上|shàng}{飞机|fēijī}，{还好|háihǎo}{路|lù}{上|shang}{车|chē}{不|bù}{多|duō}。

★ {他|tā}{没|méi}{赶|gǎn}{上|shàng}{飞机|fēijī}。
questions.explanation: **差点儿没** = almost didn't — but did.
notes: 差点儿没赶上 = almost missed it — he made it (还好).
questions.translation: I almost missed the plane — luckily there wasn't much traffic. ★ He missed the plane.

questions.prompt:
{以前|yǐqián}{我|wǒ}{每天|měitiān}{开车|kāichē}{上班|shàngbān}，{后来|hòulái}{发现|fāxiàn}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dìtiě}{更|gèng}{快|kuài}，{所以|suǒyǐ}{现在|xiànzài}{都|dōu}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dìtiě}{了|le}。{另外|lìngwài}，{坐|zuò}{地铁|dìtiě}{还|hái}{可以|kěyǐ}{在|zài}{车|chē}{上|shang}{看|kàn}{书|shū}。

★ {他|tā}{现在|xiànzài}{怎么|zěnme}{上班|shàngbān}？
questions.translation: I used to drive to work every day; later I found the subway is faster, so now I always take it. Besides, I can read on the train. ★ How does he get to work now?

questions.prompt:
{小张|Xiǎo Zhāng}{是|shì}{通过|tōngguò}{朋友|péngyou}{认识|rènshi}{他|tā}{女朋友|nǚpéngyou}{的|de}。{他们|tāmen}{第一|dì-yī}{次|cì}{见面|jiànmiàn}{是|shì}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|ge}{咖啡馆|kāfēiguǎn}，{那天|nàtiān}{正好|zhènghǎo}{下|xià}{大雨|dàyǔ}。

★ {小张|Xiǎo Zhāng}{是|shì}{怎么|zěnme}{认识|rènshi}{女朋友|nǚpéngyou}{的|de}？
notes: The rain was on their first date, at a café — they'd already been introduced.
questions.translation: Xiao Zhang met his girlfriend through a friend. Their first date was at a café, and it happened to be pouring with rain. ★ How did Xiao Zhang meet his girlfriend?

questions.prompt:
{他|tā}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{了|le}。
（{钥匙|yàoshi}・{又|yòu}・{忘|wàng}・{把|bǎ}）
questions.explanation: 他 **又 把 钥匙 忘** 在家里了。
notes: 忘 is the verb before 在家里 — slot 4.
questions.translation: He's left his keys at home again.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　。
（{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìngqù}・{中国|Zhōngguó}・{对|duì}・{历史|lìshǐ}）
questions.explanation: 我 **对 中国 历史 很感兴趣**。
notes: 很感兴趣 ends the sentence — slot 4.
中国 modifies 历史 — slot 2.
questions.translation: I'm very interested in Chinese history.

questions.prompt:
＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　，{我|wǒ}{每天|měitiān}{都|dōu}{跑步|pǎobù}。
（{健康|jiànkāng}・{身体|shēntǐ}・{为了|wèile}・{让|ràng}）
questions.explanation: **为了 让 身体 健康**，我每天都跑步。
notes: 健康 ends the clause — slot 4.
questions.translation: I run every day to stay healthy.

questions.prompt:
{你|nǐ}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　{吧|ba}。
（{老师|lǎoshī}・{问问|wènwen}・{最好|zuìhǎo}・{先|xiān}）
questions.explanation: 你 **最好 先 问问 老师** 吧。
notes: 老师 is the object — slot 4.
questions.translation: You'd better ask the teacher first.
